dependencies: relationship depends on both visible endpoints
conclusion depends on the evidence or explanation it summarizes
supporting label stays attached to its object
layout_rules: center a group conclusion against the full group
assess image and negative-space weight as well as rectangles
route connectors around padded image and label bounds
reserve caption space and safe edges throughout motion
keep moving video perceptible behind explanatory graphics
motion_rules: one coherent direction per semantic group
allow small overlaps for continuity without reversing reading order
do not delay every word mechanically
